status: Gate 3 final proposal (AQ-036, AQ-038); for owner confirmation
units: second-home permits on single-family lots per 1,000 one-unit detached homes per year
area_levels: reference/pooled_wi_y_by_area.csv (y_plateau_lower_80, y_plateau_central, y_plateau_upper_80: pooled two-stage model across California, statewide-law states, and five cities)

lower.basis: Like the slower statewide-law states: pooled model, 10th percentile of the between-state spread

central.basis: Like a typical statewide-law state: pooled model central; ramp from the pooled year terms

upper.basis: California-level response: pooled model, 90th percentile of the between-state spread (driven by California; every other statewide-law state sits below it)

statewide_adoption_line: reference/statewide_adoption_curve.csv (median observed path of statewide-law states; shown alongside the scenarios)
notes: Uniform 'level' applies only where an area has no model level. Floor 0.229 = Madison 2022-2025 rate / 0.8. The California ramp is not applied on top of the pooled ramp. Path-specific ramps reproduce the pooled model's direct totals (each path scales the whole rate path).
